I am an old woman, 58 years, and I farm this small piece of land near my house for yam and cassava to feed my family. I have no money for chemical fertilizer this season, but I will put the goat droppings and kitchen ash I have been saving on the mounds. I use the yam setts and cassava cuttings I saved from last year like my mother taught me — I do not buy new seed. My children help me weed small small, and sometimes I call one man from the village to help me make the heaps because my back is paining me.
